description: This file defines an interface for internal memory storage grain used by Orleans in-memory storage provider, enabling asynchronous read, write, and delete operations on grain state data.

classes.name: IMemoryStorageGrain
classes.description: Interface for internal memory storage grain with async methods for reading, writing, and deleting grain state data.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve the grain state data from memory store.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to update the grain state data into memory store.

methods.name: DeleteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to delete the grain state data from the store.
